# Thomas Avice

> Construction project manager who builds software and AI workflows for the jobsite. Based in San Francisco, CA.

Ten years running regulated, mission-critical Bay Area construction projects (K-12 schools, healthcare, historic renovation). Licensed California general contractor (Class B), OSHA 30, M.S. Civil Engineering & Engineering Project Management (UC Berkeley). Builds tools for RFIs, submittals, change orders, job-cost tracking, Procore integrations and AI-assisted drafting.
